page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.2xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 6462C processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include any local NVMe SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with the instance.

The high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU makes this instance class qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring substantial memory footprints without needing a high count of compute cores. It is suitable for memory-intensive applications such as databases, in-memory caching systems, and enterprise applications.
